subject: gk
question: Who has been elected as the Chairperson of the Audit Bureau of Circulations (ABC) for 2022-2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pratap Pawar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Madhukar Kamath is a former Chairman of the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI).**
 
• Ashish Agarwal is the CFO of the **Aditya Birla Group's telecom arm, Idea Cellular.**
 
• **Devendra Vijay Darda **is the **Chairman and Managing Director of Lokmat Media Pvt. Ltd**.
 
• Pratap Pawar has been elected as the Chairperson of the** ABC for the mentioned period.**
 
• Madhukar Kamath, Ashish Agarwal, and Devendra Vijay Darda are all prominent personalities in the media and advertising industry, but they are not the correct answers to the questions asked.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Audit Bureau of Circulations of India is a** non-profit circulation-auditing organization.**
 
• It certifies and audits the circulations of major publications, including newspapers and magazines in India.
 
• ABC is a **voluntary organization initiated in 1948** that operates in different parts of the world.
 
• It is headquartered in** Mumbai.**
